checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Two separate playable videos, each 10 s, one 9:16 and one 16:9
must.why: Two files of 10 s each, portrait 480x854 and landscape 854x480.

must.item: Both show rooftop musicians at sunset with consistent styling and content
must.why: Both show a jazz band on a rooftop at sunset with string lights.

must.item: Both display exactly the three text lines
must.why: Title is misspelled 'Rooffop' in both. The location is garbled in both. The 16:9 version has no date.

must.item: All three text lines fully inside frame and readable together for 3+ s
must.why: The 9:16 version shows all three lines, but the location is tiny and misspelled. The 16:9 version never shows the date.

must.item: Both fill frames without black bars, stretch or cropped faces
must.why: Both fill the frame with no bars. Faces are small but not cropped.

must.item: Both contain mellow jazz and no voiceover
must.why: Both have audio with good peak levels, but the music and speech were not heard.

exact_text.read_as: Exact in 9:16; absent from the 16:9 version

faults.what: Title misspelled 'Rooffop Jazz' in both versions
Location text garbled in both versions ('Sky Terace, Manstheer' and 'Sky Teraace, Manthsher')
The 16:9 version has no '18 July 2026' line
The 9:16 location line is very small and low-contrast, and string lights cross the date line
In the 9:16 version the camera moves toward the band and the lights pass in front of the text
Both versions are 480p and the musicians are small, so the 16:9 version will look soft on a venue screen

summary: Both videos have a good rooftop sunset jazz scene that fills the frame, but the text is misspelled in both ('Rooffop', garbled location) and the 16:9 version has no date, so neither can be used without a redo.
